display_name: Tailapa II of the Western Chalukyas
one_line: Rashtrakuta feudatory-turned Western Chalukya founder who seized Manyakheta and Kalyani in the late 10th century.

appearance.age_look: Early 40s, tall and broad-shouldered with a seasoned warrior’s build.
appearance.face: Oval face with a strong jaw, medium-brown Deccan complexion, sharp almond eyes, straight nose, neatly groomed moustache and trimmed short beard; default expression calm, strategic and dignified, with a subtle confident half-smile.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair pulled into a high, tight topknot at the crown, sides smoothed back; a simple gold circlet with a small central round gem sits low on the forehead, and a narrow cloth band in deep maroon wraps beneath it to secure the topknot.
appearance.costume: Era-accurate late 10th-century Deccan royal warrior attire: a knee-length, cream-coloured cotton tunic with short fitted sleeves and a subtle woven border at the hem; over it, a sleeveless quilted protective vest in muted bronze-brown leather with simple stitching, fitted but not bulky; a long wrapped dhoti in deep maroon, pleated to the front and draped to mid-calf, with a narrow gold border; around his waist, a broad fabric cummerbund in dark indigo tied firmly, its loose end hanging at the left hip; a diagonally draped sash in rich saffron cotton running from right shoulder to left hip, hinting at royal status; feet in sturdy brown leather sandals with ankle straps; jewellery limited to a pair of small gold hoop earrings, a single thick gold bangle on each wrist, and a short gold necklace with a modest central pendant, avoiding excessive ornament; overall look practical, courtly and battlefield-ready.
appearance.signature: A long, slightly curved steel sword with a plain but elegant iron blade, an ornate yet sturdy hilt with a rounded disc pommel and short crossguard, sheathed in a dark brown leather scabbard with simple brass fittings, worn at his left hip and held in his right hand when posed.

ref_desc: Tailapa II is a tall, broad-shouldered Deccan king with medium-brown skin, black topknot under a gold circlet, cream tunic, bronze-brown vest, deep maroon dhoti, saffron sash, dark indigo belt and a curved sword in a brown scabbard at his hip.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style historical character sheet of Tailapa II: a tall, broad-shouldered 10th-century Deccan king with an oval, medium-brown face, sharp almond eyes, neat moustache and short beard, wearing his thick black hair in a high topknot held by a simple gold circlet and a maroon headband. Show his cream knee-length tunic with short fitted sleeves beneath a sleeveless bronze-brown quilted vest, a deep maroon wrapped dhoti to mid-calf with a narrow gold border, a broad dark indigo waist-cummerbund, and a rich saffron sash draped diagonally from right shoulder to left hip. Add small gold hoop earrings, a short gold necklace with a modest pendant and one thick gold bangle on each wrist, plus sturdy brown leather sandals. At his left hip show a long, slightly curved steel sword with ornate but practical hilt and disc pommel in a dark brown leather scabbard with brass fittings, and have him lightly rest his right hand on the sword, in a calm, dignified, confident pose that can be consistently redrawn with these exact colours and details.
